description: Birmingham, AL – Today, Katherine Robertson, Conservative Republican candidate for Alabama Attorney General, announced the endorsement of Tuscaloosa County Sheriff Ron Abernathy. Robertson made the announcement on Tuscaloosa’s 95.3FM The Bear’s “Steve and DC Show.”Sheriff Abernathy, a respected law enforcement leader who has served the Tuscaloosa County Sheriff's Office since 1988 and as Sheriff since his first election in 2015, touted Robertson's extensive record of supporting law enforcement,

title: Tuscaloosa County Sheriff Ron Abernathy Endorses Katherine Robertson for Alabama Attorney General
